# SpanTunnel v2 smoke fixture —— 覆盖 DESIGN-v2.md §2.3 的 18 项边界
# 全局区（首块之前）关键字被解析器忽略
ForwardAgent yes

Host *
  StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new

Host bastion bastion.corp.com
  HostName bastion.corp.com
  Port 2222
  User deploy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_work
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_work_backup
  ProxyJump jump1.corp.com
  LocalForward 18080 127.0.0.1:8000
  RemoteForward 0.0.0.0:9000 127.0.0.1:9000
  DynamicForward 11080

Host gpu-box
  hostname 10.0.3.21
  DynamicForward 127.0.0.1:11081
  ProxyJump bastion

Host dev-*
  User dev

Match host internal.example.com
  User matched

Include ~/.ssh/conf.d/work

host web-dev
  HostName web-dev.internal
  Port=2222
  localforward 8080 127.0.0.1:80
  HostName duplicate.ignored

Host broken
  LocalForward 8080
  LocalForward [::1]:8081 ::1:80
  DynamicForward 70000
  LocalForward 99999x 127.0.0.1:80

Host
  User nobody

Host dup
  User a
Host dup
  User b
  LocalForward 1234 127.0.0.1:5678
